newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans slide after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans slide after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans closed sharply lower Monday, dragged down by the fall in Chicago, traders said.

Volume was low, with market players avoiding physical trade and mainly limiting themselves to covering in the futures exchange. FAS elevator soybeans slid $10 to $250 in Rosario. Cash maize, hit by the drop in soybeans and international prices, lost $3 in Buenos Aires to $97, in thin trade. Sunflower seed prices also fell in low turnover, losing $4 in Rosario to $218.
